# M. Yusuf Akçakaya (@fusuyfusuy)

> Boğaziçi University · Research Assistant · Management Information Systems, PhD

Experience in cyber security red/blue practice, network infrastructure, regulations, risk management, and AI orchestration. I gave trainings and wrote blog posts about cyber security, developed web pages, and managed e-mail, web, and VPN servers. I code mostly with Python and JS/TS, now everything with AI. I also have experience with C, Java, PHP, SQL, and shell scripting.
